title: GossipConfigContract
description: Configuration schema for the gemini_gossip section in EconomyCraft config.json

enabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable Gemini villager gossip

api_key.description: Google Gemini API key. If left blank, reads GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable

model.description: Model ID to invoke via the Generative Language REST API

refresh_interval_minutes.description: Frequency in minutes between background transaction digestion runs

cooldown_minutes.description: Minutes before the same villager will speak to the same player again

anonymize_players.description: Whether to map player names to contextual archetypes in prompts

public_chat.description: Whether villager gossip is broadcast publicly to all players (true) or delivered privately to the trading player (false)
